Nizam

Our Majlis, and the history and organisation of the worldwide Ahmadiyya Muslim Jama’at

Our Aim

To train and educate every member, including the Atfāl, in true Islamic ways: love for Allah and the Holy Prophet(sa), and a spirit of serving Islam, the country and mankind.

The Line of Khilafat

The Ahmadiyya Muslim Jama’at

From a first pledge of allegiance in a small Punjabi city to a worldwide community led by Khilafat. Explore the full story and how the Jama’at is organised.

History

The Nizam of the Jama’at

The same structure repeats at international, national, regional and local level. Tap a level to open it.

Auxiliary Organisations

Run in parallel at every level. National and international heads (Sadr) are appointed by the Khalifa.

Departments of the Centre (Nazarāt)

The Sadr Anjuman Ahmadiyya, headed by the Nazir A‘la, is made up of Nazarāt headed by Nuzarā’.
